upstreamDescriptor.source: pinned OpenClaw 2026.9.1 public environment protocol and descriptor evidence

upstreamIdentityContract.workerProfileId: The create request field profileId selects a configured worker profile.
upstreamIdentityContract.providerId: The public worker summary field identifies the underlying provider implementation.
upstreamIdentityContract.environmentId: The public environment summary id identifies the native environment.
upstreamIdentityContract.idempotencyKey: The create request accepts a native idempotencyKey; it is not returned as a public operation identity in the list/status/create summary contract.

publicEnvironmentSummary.destroyedStatusMapping: native worker.state=destroyed may be returned with status=unavailable

environmentCreate.idempotencyKeyGeneratedBy: AgentOS server generates one key and sends it once to OpenClaw
environmentCreate.normalSuccess: Native response is returned as succeeded without speculative reread.
environmentCreate.definiteRejection: failed; no reconciliation read and no retry.
environmentCreate.ambiguousOutcome: One authoritative environments.list reread is performed, but the public 2026.9.1 contract does not expose enough create identity for causal proof, so outcome is unknown.
environmentCreate.sameProviderConcurrentCreates: Safe against false success; a same-provider new row remains unknown without exact operation identity.
environmentCreate.sourceStatusRequirement: A topology reread with sourceStatus unknown/unavailable cannot prove create identity.

environmentDestroy.normalSuccess: Native response is returned as succeeded without speculative reread.
environmentDestroy.definiteRejection: failed; no reconciliation success and no retry.
environmentDestroy.ambiguousOutcome: One authoritative environments.list reread with causal post-state verification.
environmentDestroy.absentRow: Reconciled success only when reread sourceStatus is available and the target was not already destroyed.
environmentDestroy.retainedDestroyedRow: Reconciled success when the same native environment id transitions from non-terminal to worker.state=destroyed, including status=unavailable.
environmentDestroy.failed: unknown; not treated as successful destruction.
environmentDestroy.orphaned: unknown; not treated as successful destruction.
environmentDestroy.preExistingDestroyedState: unknown under ambiguous delivery; the existing terminal state cannot prove causality.

mutationTruthfulness.ambiguousDelivery: No retry; one bounded authoritative reread; causal proof or unknown.
